ablations.description: Full system: Proactive optimizer + Connection synchronization + Conformal ETA + Demand nowcast
Disables exponential decay delay correction and real-time dwell residual model
Optimizer ignores Hub S03 4-min transfer buffer constraint (H7/H8 without transfer protection)
Uses static historical mean demand; disables Poisson nowcast multiplier & event awareness

sensitivity.description: Standard pre-declared composite objective favoring service reliability.
Aggressively minimizes passenger wait and dwell queues.
Heavily penalizes broken transfers at Central Hub S03.
Penalizes additional vehicle-km and plan churn for fuel savings.
